about: Each spec file's seconds in the core run on CI (--grep-invert @full), the boot counted in the file that paid it, from the per-file times the shards print (tests/e2e/fileTimes.ts): copy them from a push's run, never the night's. scripts/ci-shards.mjs deals the files out by them; a file not here counts newFile seconds. From CI run 44255701920 (134, 2026-11-18), read from the log's timestamps; 05, 35 and 10-15 were shared out of their shard's total by their time here. 16-view's 1,086 s shared out among its four parts by their tests' own times, each part a few seconds more for its own filling of the farm and its "afterwards".
